definition.name: Kisan-Orchestrator
definition.workflow:
kind: workflow
trigger:
  kind: OnConversationStart
  id: trigger_wf
  actions:
    - kind: SetMultipleVariables
      id: SetVarUserMessage
      assignments:
        - variable: Local.UserMessage
          value: =UserMessage(System.LastMessage.Text)
        - variable: Local.QuestionText
          value: =System.LastMessage.Text
    - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
      id: router_agent
      agent:
        name: Router
      conversationId: =System.ConversationId
      input:
        messages: =Local.UserMessage
      output:
        autoSend: true
        responseObject: Local.OrchestratorResponse
    - kind: SetVariable
      id: SetRouterVar
      variable: Local.Route
      value: =Local.OrchestratorResponse.route
    - kind: ConditionGroup
      conditions:
        - condition: =Local.Route = "apple"
          actions:
            - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
              id: apple_agent
              agent:
                name: protect-prevent
              conversationId: =System.ConversationId
              input:
                messages: =Local.UserMessage
              output:
                autoSend: true
                responseObject: Local.SpecialistResponse
          id: if-node-1785240280979-90yt3fiq
      id: node-1785240280979
      elseActions:
        - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
          id: kcc_agent
          agent:
            name: kcc-agent
          conversationId: =System.ConversationId
          input:
            messages: =Local.UserMessage
          output:
            autoSend: true
            responseObject: Local.SpecialistResponse
    - kind: ConditionGroup
      conditions:
        - condition: =Local.SpecialistResponse.status = "DIAGNOSED"
          actions:
            - kind: InvokeAzureAgent
              id: product_agent
              agent:
                name: product-recommendation-agent
              conversationId: =System.ConversationId
              input:
                messages: =If(     !IsBlank(Local.SpecialistResponse.diagnosis_name) || !IsBlank(Local.SpecialistResponse.answer.fil_recommendation),     UserMessage(Text(Local.SpecialistResponse.diagnosis_name) & " " & Text(Local.SpecialistResponse.answer.fil_recommendation)),     Blank() )
              output:
                autoSend: true
                responseObject: Local.ProductResponse
            - kind: SetVariable
              id: node-output
              variable: Local.FinalMessage
              value: =Text(Local.SpecialistResponse.display_message) & If(IsBlank(Local.ProductResponse), "", Char(10) & Char(10) & Text(Local.ProductResponse.products_text))
            - kind: EndConversation
              id: node-1785242091084
          id: if-node-1785240968917-rvy9k4k9
      id: node-1785240968917
      elseActions:
        - kind: SetVariable
          id: node-clarification
          variable: Local.FinalMessage
          value: =Local.SpecialistResponse.display_message
        - kind: EndConversation
          id: node-1785242096628
id: ""
name: Kisan-Orchestrator
